The API SLA risk calculator successfully passed all verification tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating robust logic for weighted risk assessment.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.65 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.722s. While the logic is reusable, the lower judge_reward suggests a need to re-check edge case handling or documentation clarity despite passing the functional verifier.
